repeat_slide.heading: Native scroll slider
repeat_slide.text: Uses native scrolling and scroll snapping. The slider stops at the first and last slide rather than cloning slides for an infinite loop.

autoplay.heading: Autoplay slider
autoplay.text: Advances every five seconds. Use the Pause button to stop movement; it becomes Play when paused.

slider_with_cards.heading: Responsive columns
slider_with_cards.text: The maximum is four cards per page. CSS container queries set one, two, three or four columns based on the slider's own width, so a slider in a narrow column adapts independently of the viewport. This example uses slideByPage, so each control moves every visible card at once.

compact_navigation.heading: Compact navigation with a next-slide peek
compact_navigation.text: This example is deliberately constrained to a 32 rem container, so the next-card peek is visible here too. Below a 640 px slider container, the arrows move below the content for 44 px touch targets. When a title is supplied, the arrows instead share its row.
